Content: Families are mixed. Chosen families. Can have multiple partners.
Families are mixed and diverse and chosen and multigenerational.
Lineages are not straight lines.

Community is intergenerational and multicultural. Families have the means and support to remain together across generations - whatever that requires. Healers are available to help families deal with trauma inherited from ancestors and learn to address it. Bodies of all abilities are supported to experience life to its healthiest and fullest - however that is defined by the person with that body. We celebrate death as much as we celebrate life because death now is a natural part of the journey - not something that comes as the result of violence or disease (OK, I recognize that this is incredibly idealistic - but we ARE dreaming here). Let's go with especially not the violence part.
Parents are well cared for. There is paid parental leave and other needed support.

This brings us to the idea of love and intimacy. There is no concept of possessive or exclusive love. The emotional connections between people is still there but belonging has replaced loneliness. There is no need to fear being alone, and people are not afraid to love those they're with.
Families, elders, and people with and without children or parents live together in ways that ensure everyone belongs.
Households and families are expansive.
Family is expansive. It’s beyond the bloodlines. Relationships of all kinds are family. Honesty, care, etc. is practiced deeply.
Our beloveds are in no matter limited-we love whoever, however, whenever, and wherever. We consent and appreciate.
Relationships have give and take. You can feel an undulation in relationships that people are practiced in tending to. Giving and receiving. Being in service.
Communities are family. Resources, care, love, food, advice, joy, and sorrow are freely shared by all as family.
Conflict is seen as an opportunity to deepen relationship, be curious about one another, and learn to make space for everything that’s coming up.
Babies cared for by all in the community.
Communication between siblings
We continue to evolve.  We understand we help each other through pleasure and pain.  That it is a murmuration to continue to move toward light.

Date/Circle Name: 2/1/25 St Louis Park, MN BIPOC The Coven
Content: Abundant gratitude and love for 3 nephews. Children value being in nature.

The nuclear family is not the only family people recognize. They understand their kinship with all creation. Neighbors are trusted like spouses, aunts/uncles, and grandparents. People are not focused on outcomes, but journeys.
5 years of parental leave for all birthing people.
Within the home, partners have coherence in values and practice and the family thinks about how they collectively contribute to the community.

Family units have moved away from heteronormative structures. Families are dynamics created from birth to death that are expanded upon and deeply cared for. The sense of family is felt by all living and inanimate beings. We are married to the whole, not to one other. We are married to the web of connection and family that is created because of that web.

Birthing bodies are celebrated with reverence always. Holding the deep truth that we come from the inside of a body and bodies are sacred. Birthing bodies and the bodies that come from bodies. EVERYONE.

When people walk through the airports, you no longer see people taking tablets away from kids for punishment.  Instead, kids are part of generations of people who create into need and beauty–and they are encouraged to create.

Date/Circle Name: 2/27/25 Redwood City and North Fair Oaks, CA Sobrato 2
Content: Parents are present in despair and joy.  There is dancing, etc.  We intervene before bad things happen.

Kids feel safe and secure.  Parents are curious about the needs of all children and about other parents.  They take an active interest.  There is no longer a norm of not talking about things or mentioning things to avoid discomfort. Everyone wants to understand how to help.

Moms are never socially isolated–and social media isn’t their only solution for connection.  It is easy to get to social time in the parks…and there are indoor spaces – coffee shops, food, etc with bounce houses and trustworthy childcare. There are options everywhere so you can come be yourself with others.

There are centrally located buildings that hold responsibility for supporting mothers.  The staffing is built around peers whose purpose is to support others.  Learning spaces are designed so older moms (elders) and younger moms learn together.
Queer loving and polyamorous families are normal and celebrated. Relationships of neighbor and friend are coveted.
Every baby is cherished and has equal opportunities from birth

families live in collectives and across generations and are deeply tied & connected to madre tierra, growing food together, compartiendo entre comunidad, elders help when conflict arises, midwives who also live in our community deliver our babies.
Work time is structured to support family life.
Families can afford housing, food, and other things.  Supplies that are need are…supplied.
There is more family time.  More friends spending time together.  Friday is fun day in a 4 day work week.
Those who can contribute do but know their families are cared for.
Families are united and in community in a beautiful place like a field

Date/Circle Name: 10/29/25 Kailua, HI Kahanaiki Group, Le Jardin Academy
Content: In this island family, we raise money to house and feed the homeless to grow our family. We’re a family that figures out a sustainable way of transportation throughout the island, a way to not have to burn fossil fuels, not only hurting this place but the rest of the world.
All our relatives are healthy – two legged, four legged, waters, air, and land
Holding hands with my grandma and daughter as we joyfully watch the sun set and hear the stories of our people
My mommy and other immigrant daughters returning home
Multi generational families living together with housing, food, returning to traditional forms of communication
Older people and kids can live with their families. Families can take care of them without going crazy
Weekly neighborhood campfires rotate amongst families, involves a raffle, and is led by the children.
The family structure and domestic violence will have collapsed. Recovery from the lineage of DV in one family tree.
Sex has no shame or stigma.  No one is forced to be pregnant or parent.  Women are part of all conversations.
Birth is still messy, human, safe, reverent, and sacred.  We carry forward the good things from the current world and root into the ancient practices that carry so much wisdom.

I see my (future) wife, my kids, my family living peacefully and not out of fear and survival or even necessity. Safety and protection for women and children are taken more seriously. They will voice their ancestors. All Mothers and infants will get the care, love, and support they need to thrive and survive. Holistic birth and labor practices, human milk banks, postpartum holistic support, infant and toddler support.  No policing and collecting of data to harm families.

Our SEA queer folx will experience healthy cultural practices, healing and love. Able to make choices for ourselves in how we want our bodies to be. All bodies, abilities and neurotypes are validated, loved, and met where they are at.  Bodies aren’t valued more or less based on how they look or what they can/can’t do.I’d be in the arms of my lover as we gaze onto the beauty of our gay little lives. We see our queer found family alive, happy and well.

A world where our future sons are raised with more help and awareness and proper guidance to not inflict the same harm, mistakes as the previous leaders have. More SEA cis males in restorative and transformative spaces as allies.
Less children are born due to all women receiving education and access to birth control.
My dog is dying and I cannot save him.
We are all family community.

Jetsons community housing  where everyone is family. Families helping families. How do we know that we are willing? Mutual stewardship. Love the Lord. Love your neighbor. Do no harm to your neighbor because of love, freedom. There are no divisions. Love God. Love one another. Love is blind.
